text:
Yuki: hi team, first-week question 44b trying to get the onboarding PR to pass CI. Buildkite clones OK but the test step dies while installing deps with timeout errors. GH Actions on ubuntu-latest passes though. not sure who to ping for network/firewall stuff.

Dave: welcome Yuki! :tada: rough guess: your Buildkite job is running on our Dedicated agents in the VPC which lack internet egress (no NAT) so pip can't reach pypi. can you paste the pip error?

Yuki: here's the Buildkite console snippet: 
```
Collecting requests
  Retrying (Retry(total=4, connect=None, read=None, redirect=None)) after connection error: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='pypi.org', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /simple/requests/ (Caused by NewConnectionError('<urllib3.connection.VerifiedHTTPSConnection object at 0x7f...>: Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno 101] Network is unreachable'))
Command "python -m pip install -r requirements.txt" exited with 1
```

netops-bot: Note: Some Buildkite agent pools run inside the private VPC (dedicated agents). Those agents require outbound NAT or an HTTP proxy to access the public internet.

Asha: yep the "onboarding" pipeline uses the dedicated agent pool by default for faster images, but that pool is in the private subnet. Two options: 1) provision NAT gateway / egress for that subnet (netops task) or 2) use an internal mirror (artifact proxy) or vendor wheels into the repo for onboarding.

Yuki: ah that explains why GH Actions passes (hosted runner has internet). does infra have a quick workaround so my PR can finish today?

Dave: short-term: we can re-run your Buildkite job on the "general" agent group which has internet egress (public subnet). tagging the job to use agent group: general will bypass the VPC agents. long-term we'll ask netops to add NAT for the dedicated pool.

buildkite-bot: Build #99 started on agent group: general (re-run per user request).

Yuki: nice, re-run in general group started but now failing at a different step: docker pull of our internal base image times out. I think that image is hosted in a private registry the VPC can reach but public runners cannot.

Asha: yep avatar: the base image lives in the internal registry (artifactory.internal) which is only reachable from VPC. two-phase problem: public runners can reach pypi but not internal registry; VPC runners reach registry but not pypi.

Dave: solution options: 1) temporarily change the job to skip docker pull and use a lightweight base image (ubuntu:20.04) for onboarding runs, or 2) push a copy of the internal base image to a publicly accessible onboarding registry for new hires, or 3) configure a proxy that gives both internet and internal registry access. For today I'd recommend option 1 or 2.

Yuki: option 1 sounds easiest. how do i skip the pull? the pipeline does `docker pull redwood-internal/base:latest` in setup.

Asha: push a small PR to the pipeline config that wraps the pull with `if [[ "$BUILDKITE_BRANCH" =~ ^onboarding/ ]]; then echo "skip pull for onboarding"; else docker pull ...; fi`. then re-run on general agent.

buildkite-bot: Build #100 queued on agent group: general (with onboarding branch pipeline tweak).

Yuki: did that tweak and requeued. Build now progresses past the docker step but fails while trying to pip install from our internal package index (packages.internal) with certificate verify failed.

Dave: internal package index uses a private CA and the public runners don't have the CA bundle. you can point pip to ignore certs (not ideal) or vendor wheels into the repo. better: netops can add the CA to the runner images used by general agent group, or we can configure pip to use an authenticated tunnel to the registry.

netops-bot: Action required: engage eng-infra-networking to approve temporary egress NAT + CA bundle update on onboarding runners. Contact: #eng-infra-networking or ping @Dave for approval.

Yuki: who do i ping to get the CA added? I'm new and don't want to jump the wrong queue.

Asha: ping #eng-infra-networking and @Dave. If you DM me the PR link I can fast-track an onboarding exception for the CA and a short-lived mirror for the base image so you can finish your first PR.

Dave: done 2712 requested mirror + CA addition for onboarding branch. Netops will add NAT in parallel but that takes infra change windows.

buildkite-bot: Build #100 succeeded on agent group: general (after pipeline tweak and mirror).

Yuki: build green! :tada: huge thanks. summary for my notes: "If Buildkite jobs fail on pip/git/network on dedicated agents, check whether the agent pool is in a VPC without egress; for onboarding use general agents or vendor deps/mirror images; contact #eng-infra-networking for NAT/CA additions; if job needs internal registry access request an onboarding mirror."

Asha: great summary. i'll add a short section to docs/onboarding/ci.md about VPC egress, internal registries, and the temporary knobs (skip pull, vendor deps). also adding who-to-ask: #eng-infra-networking, @Dave, @Asha.

Yuki: thanks again everyone, appreciate the speedy help. excited to be here! :coffee:
